lessons.title: Welcome to Northport
lessons.subtitle: A walk around the terminal
brief: Meet your instructor and learn the layout of Northport Terminal 1.
No lifting in this lesson — just get comfortable with the machine and the HUD.

goals.label: Start the machine
goals.hint: The machine is already running — press any control to confirm you are in the seat.

goals.label: Drive to training pad 1
goals.hint: Follow the turquoise marker. W forward, S reverse, A and D to steer.

goals.label: Drive to training pad 2
goals.hint: Swing around and drive across to pad 2. Take it slow.

goals.label: Drive to training pad 3
goals.hint: One more pad — reverse out, then forward again.

lessons.success: That is the layout. Familiar ground now — next we put the forks to work.
tips: Nothing in this lesson can be failed. Drive, look around, get used to the camera.

lessons.title: Forklift Basics
lessons.subtitle: Movement, steering and braking
brief: Get comfortable with the forklift: drive it, steer it, stop it and sound the horn.
Forks stay low for this whole lesson.

goals.label: Drive 45 m
goals.hint: Hold W and steer with A and D.

goals.label: Reverse 12 m
goals.hint: Hold S — the forklift steers with its rear wheels, so the tail swings.

goals.label: Come to a full stop
goals.hint: Press Space (or release the throttle) until the speed reads zero.

goals.label: Sound the horn once
goals.hint: H is the horn.

goals.label: Finish parked on pad 1
goals.hint: Line up with the pad and stop inside it.

lessons.success: You can drive it. Now let's make it lift.
tips: Braking distance grows with speed and load. Brake earlier than feels fair.

lessons.title: Forks and Loads
lessons.subtitle: Raising, picking up and setting down
brief: Learn the fork controls, then pick up a pallet and place it on the marked pad.
Forks enter the pallet openings — come in square and low.

goals.label: Raise the forks to 1 m
goals.hint: Hold R to raise the forks.

goals.label: Lower the forks back down
goals.hint: Hold F to lower them to the deck.

goals.label: Pick up a pallet
goals.hint: Line the tines up with the pallet openings, forks low, then press E.

goals.label: Set the pallet on pad 2
goals.hint: Lower the forks over pad 2 until the pallet rests, then press E to release.

lessons.success: Forks, load, and a tidy set-down. That is the core of warehouse work.
tips: Never travel with the forks raised above 1.5 m — that is where tip-overs start.

lessons.title: Warehouse Run
lessons.subtitle: A full delivery with capacity checks
brief: Deliver a pallet from the training area to the warehouse dock.
You will cross the south road and pass a pedestrian walkway — give way.

goals.label: Deliver it to the warehouse dock
goals.hint: The dock doors are on the red-striped apron at the west face of the warehouse.

lessons.success: Delivered clean. The reach stacker is unlocked — that is your next machine.
tips: Capacity is printed on the machine panel. Check it before lifting anything unusual.

lessons.title: Reach Stacker Basics
lessons.subtitle: Boom, spreader and twistlocks
brief: Meet the reach stacker: boom up and down, telescope out and in, and cycle the spreader.
Nothing to carry yet — learn the axes first.

goals.label: Raise the boom
goals.hint: Hold R.

goals.label: Lower the boom
goals.hint: Hold F.

goals.label: Extend the boom fully
goals.hint: Hold T to telescope out.

goals.label: Retract the boom
goals.hint: Hold G to telescope in.

goals.label: Cycle the spreader 40 → 20 ft
goals.hint: C cycles the spreader length.

lessons.success: You have the axes. Now put a box on the ground and lock onto it.
tips: Extend the boom only when the machine is stationary.

lessons.title: First Container
lessons.subtitle: Lift, carry and stack a 20 ft box
brief: Lift the loose 20 ft container on the apron and stack it in the yard block.
Watch the capacity chart: this machine lifts less in the second row.

goals.label: Lift a container
goals.hint: Cycle the spreader to the box size, lower the boom over the corners, then press E.

goals.label: Stack it in Block S2
goals.hint: Drive into the lane beside Block S2 and lower the box into a free slot.

lessons.success: Box stacked, spreader released, no damage. That is container handling.
tips: A 40 ft box straddling two 20 ft slots wastes yard space — keep boxes in their own bay.

lessons.title: Gantry Crane Basics
lessons.subtitle: Travel, trolley and hoist
brief: The RTG straddles its block. Learn to travel along it and trolley across it.
You will not leave the block in this lesson.

goals.label: Travel 8 m along the block
goals.hint: W and S travel the gantry. It is slow — that is by design.

goals.label: Trolley 4 m across the span
goals.hint: T and G move the trolley across the block.

goals.label: Lower the hoist to container level
goals.hint: F lowers the hoist, R raises it.

lessons.success: Axes mastered. Next: retrieve a box from the stack.
tips: Never trolley with the spreader close to the ground — a swing can drag a stack.

lessons.title: Harbour Crane Basics
lessons.subtitle: Luffing, hoisting and the radius chart
brief: The mobile harbour crane uses a hook and a luffing boom.
Capacity falls as you reach out — read the panel while you work the boom.

goals.label: Raise the boom to maximum
goals.hint: T raises the boom (luff), G lowers it.

goals.label: Lower the boom to reach out
goals.hint: G pays the boom out — watch the capacity figure drop.

goals.label: Lower the hook
goals.hint: F lowers the hook.

goals.label: Raise the hook back up
goals.hint: R raises the hook.

lessons.success: That is the heavy-lift machine. Use it whenever the RTG cannot reach.
tips: Radius and capacity are a straight trade. Short radius, big lift.
